sqketvxw.variantName: VeryMerry 6FT Snowhill Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 8 Modes Timer - Warm White
sqketvxw.sourceDescription: PRE-LIT LED TREE DÉCOR: This Snowshill Pre-Lit Christmas Tree is a must-have for the festive season. Measuring at 6 feet high with a diameter of 100cm, this tree will have no problems being the centrepiece of your home over the Christmas period. Fitted with 300 warm white LED lights with 8 different light settings and a timer, this tree is sure to be the centre of attention this Christmas. LUXURY FINISH: The gorgeous ever-green tree is finished with 715 tips to ensure that it always looks thick, bushy and plump. The tips also allow you to dress the tree with your chosen decorations with ease. Please note that some time will need to be spent arranging the tree to achieve the desired look. STURDY BASE: This festive tree comes with a sturdy metal base which ensures your tree is always fully balanced and remains in place whilst in use. The tree is made up of 3 different sections complete with hinged branches making it hassle-free to assemble, dismantle and store away. LONG-LASTING: This beautiful Christmas tree is made from high-quality PVC which not only gives the tree a more realistic look, but it also means that this tree can be used for many years due to its high durability. This product is made with fire resistant material to provide you and your home with extra safety. DIMENSIONS: This tree stands at 6 feet high and has a diameter of 100cm. WEIGHT: 9.5KG Please refer to the product packaging and user manual for applicable safety warnings and instructions. Consumable Direct Ltd, 78 Cawdor St, Eccles, Manchester, M30 0QF

The included stand provides a stable base while you arrange the branches and add your favourite baubles, ribbons, tinsel and decorative lights. Designed for straightforward assembly, the tree offers the look of traditional evergreen foliage without the maintenance of a natural tree. Suitable for indoor and outdoor decorative displays, it works well in living rooms, hallways, offices, entrances and other festive spaces. 4FT ARTIFICIAL CHRISTMAS TREE: Measures approximately 125cm tall, making it suitable for compact festive displays in homes, offices and entrances. 280 REALISTIC PINE TIPS: Features 280 green branch tips arranged to create a natural pine-inspired appearance for traditional Christmas decorating. hrhgjnwj.baseName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
hrhgjnwj.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
hrhgjnwj.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 7ft Pre-lit Slim Wildhorn Pine. This elegant artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 400 multi-function warm white LED lights in a slender shape, making it a lovely choice for smaller living rooms, apartments and cosy corners. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Slim Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. It offers a beautifully full look within a narrow silhouette. It has gently upswept branches and a slim, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. At 7ft tall, it brings height to your festive display while keeping its footprint compact. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display. The tree comes in three sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 7ft • Pre-lit: 400 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 890 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree width: 90cm diameter • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches and three tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 60cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Supplied in one carton • Carton dimensions: 100cm × 30cm × 32cm • Weight: 10.80kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

a8emdh67.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
a8emdh67.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
a8emdh67.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree is a pristine embodiment of contemporary style blended with classic holiday spirit. Designed to bring life and light to any room or outdoor shelter, its lush green branches made from durable PVC and PE offer a realistic and lasting appearance. Perfect for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use, the tree stands as a centerpiece of seasonal décor, effortlessly transforming any living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland, suitable for gatherings, celebrations, or quiet family moments. Quality Materials: Crafted from a durable combination of PVC and PE, this tree stands out for its ability to mimic the natural look and feel of a genuine Christmas tree, ensuring it remains a cherished part of your seasonal décor for years. Sturdy Construction: Supported by a robust iron stand, the tree remains firm and stable, providing a sound foundation for your holiday ornaments and lights, thus safeguarding your seasonal decorations from tilting or toppling over. Modern Design: This tree adopts a sleek, modern design with minimal ornamentation, making it a versatile choice for spaces that value simplicity without sacrificing festive spirit. This design exudes timeless elegance, ensuring it complements various décor styles seamlessly. Seasonal Versatility: Perfect for both living rooms and sheltered outdoor areas, this tree engages the holiday spirit in diverse environments. Its adjustable features provide the flexibility to fit within different spatial setups, making it truly adaptable. Easy Maintenance: The tree comes with straightforward assembly instructions, requiring just a screwdriver and the efforts of two people, making it a convenient choice for those looking to decorate with minimal fuss during the busy holiday rush. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC, pe and steel Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 105 cm Stand size: 46.5 x 46.5 cm Durable Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
